_comment: ironwork's compiler messages by id, as docs/messages.md lists them, with the remedy cobolwork gives each W, E and X message. GENERATED by diag/ironwork-messages.mjs: messages and source are rewritten on each run; remedies and defaultRemedies are written by hand and kept.

defaultRemedies.X: The form is Micro Focus or GnuCOBOL, and Enterprise COBOL refuses it: rewrite it in the Enterprise COBOL form the message names.
defaultRemedies.C: Make the fix the message names, so the program says what it compiles as.
defaultRemedies.O: Resolve the option conflict on the program's CBL or PROCESS card: keep the option the program needs and remove the one IBM overrides.
defaultRemedies.S: Correct the source as the message says, rather than relying on how the compiler recovered from it.

remedies.IWC0055: End the program explicitly: add GOBACK after the last statement that should run, or STOP RUN where the program must end the run unit.
remedies.IWC0056: Write the CALL to CEEDAYS, which gives the Lilian date INTDATE(LILIAN) uses, or compile with INTDATE(ANSI) where the program needs CEECBLDY's ANSI integer date.
remedies.IWC0098: Add a REPLACING phrase for a category the group holds, or drop REPLACING so INITIALIZE sets every item; as written the statement changes nothing.
remedies.IWC0111: Compile with RENT: remove NORENT from the CBL or PROCESS card, since the options the message names compile only as RENT.
remedies.IWC0112: Add the options the message names as missing (THREAD, DLL, RENT, DBCS) to the program's CBL or PROCESS card, as IBM requires for object-oriented syntax.
remedies.IWC0113: Remove INITIAL from the PROGRAM-ID paragraph, or compile without THREAD: under THREAD IBM compiles the program as NOINITIAL, so it does not get fresh storage on each call.
remedies.IWC0289: Set the item on every path to this statement: a VALUE clause, or a MOVE or INITIALIZE before the branch that can reach it unset.
remedies.IWC0290: Give the item a value before this statement: a VALUE clause, or a MOVE or INITIALIZE on the path that reaches it.
remedies.IWO0002: Choose a CURRENCY symbol that is a currency character in the program's code page, or compile under the code page the symbol was written for.
remedies.IWO0003: Remove NODBCS from the CBL or PROCESS card: NSYMBOL(NATIONAL) keeps DBCS in effect, so the card does not do what it says.
remedies.IWS0025: Replace the character with the COBOL character meant, or keep it only inside a literal or a comment line.
remedies.IWS0099: Shorten the name to 30 characters or fewer, and check that its first 30 do not match another name's.
remedies.IWS0100: Move the statement into Area B, column 12 or later.
remedies.IWS0104: Remove the scope terminator, or open the statement it is meant to end, and check that the statements around it nest as intended.
remedies.IWS0105: Write the period before the word, where the compiler assumed one, so the source says what it compiles as.
remedies.IWS0106: Write the literal with at least one character, or name SPACE, LOW-VALUE or another figurative constant where an empty value is meant.
remedies.IWX0001: Convert the file to fixed form: sequence area in columns 1 to 6, indicator in column 7, Area A from column 8, and nothing past column 72.
remedies.IWX0002: Replace the level-78 or CONSTANT entry with a data item that has the value in a VALUE clause, or write the literal where the name is used.
remedies.IWX0004: Write the literals as one literal, continued on the next line with a hyphen in column 7 where it is long.
remedies.IWX0005: Declare the item with a numeric PICTURE and USAGE COMP-5 of the size the message gives.
remedies.IWX0006: Write IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. before the PROGRAM-ID paragraph.
remedies.IWX0007: Assign the file to a fixed DD name and name the data set in the job's JCL, or allocate it dynamically (BPXWDYN) before the OPEN.
remedies.IWX0008: Write COMPUTE target = FUNCTION name (...) in place of the MOVE.
remedies.IWX0009: Remove RETURNING OMITTED from the PROCEDURE DIVISION header; the program returns its RETURN-CODE without it.
remedies.IWX0010: Take the job step's PARM through PROCEDURE DIVISION USING a LINKAGE SECTION record (a halfword length and the text), in place of the command-line ACCEPT or DISPLAY.
remedies.IWX0011: Write the colon before the host variable: INTO :name.
remedies.IWX0012: Write the VALUE as an alphanumeric literal in the item's edited form.
remedies.IWX0013: Remove END-DISPLAY or END-ACCEPT, and end the statement with the next verb or a period.
remedies.IWX0014: Write VALUE in place of VALUES outside a level-88 entry.
remedies.IWX0015: Shorten the name to 30 characters or fewer, keeping it distinct from every other name in its first 30.
remedies.IWX0016: Declare the item as a two-byte binary item (PIC S9(4) COMP-5, or PIC 9(4) COMP-5 where it is unsigned), and check every record layout that relies on its being one byte.
remedies.IWX0017: Move the statement into Area B, column 12 or later.
remedies.IWX0018: Pass the function an alphanumeric item: move the numeric item's digits to a PIC X item first, or name a REDEFINES of it.
remedies.IWX0019: Move the table to a level from 02 to 49 under an 01 record of its own.
remedies.IWX0020: Replace the screen DISPLAY or ACCEPT with the interface the program runs under on z/OS: a BMS map under CICS, an ISPF panel under TSO, or SYSIN and SYSOUT in batch.
remedies.IWX0021: Take the setting from the job step's PARM, a control record read through a DD, or Language Environment's CEEENV service, in place of the environment variable.
remedies.IWX0022: Remove the locking phrase, and serialise access to the data set as z/OS does: its DISP in the JCL, VSAM share options, or CICS file control.
remedies.IWX0023: Count or replace the trailing occurrences another way: INSPECT FUNCTION REVERSE of the item with LEADING, or a loop from the end of the item.
remedies.IWX0024: Remove the RETURNING phrase from the CALL; where the caller's RETURN-CODE must survive it, save RETURN-CODE before the CALL and restore it after.
remedies.IWX0025: Declare the item as a binary item of two, four or eight bytes (PIC 9(n) COMP-5), and check every record layout it is part of.
remedies.IWX0026: Declare the item with a numeric PICTURE of the same size, PIC 9(n) COMP-5, or keep it PIC X(n) and reach its bytes through a REDEFINES.
remedies.IWX0027: Write COMP-1 for FLOAT-SHORT and COMP-2 for FLOAT-LONG, and check any result that relied on IEEE binary floating point, since COMP-1 and COMP-2 are hexadecimal.
remedies.IWX0028: Write PERFORM UNTIL with a condition the loop sets when it should end, in place of FOREVER.
remedies.IWX0029: Remove the ACCEPT, and take the screen size from the terminal the program runs under, such as EXEC CICS ASSIGN SCRNHT and SCRNWD.
remedies.IWX0030: Write the line with AFTER ADVANCING, moving the advance to the next WRITE, or define the file as a print file.
remedies.IWX0031: Pass the caller's PROGRAM-ID to the program as an argument of the CALL.
remedies.IWX0032: Move the level-66 RENAMES entry after the record's last entry.
remedies.IWX0033: Move the value to RETURN-CODE, then write STOP RUN or GOBACK without RETURNING or GIVING.
remedies.IWX0034: Write ADDRESS OF name = NULL, or NOT = NULL, in place of OMITTED or NOT OMITTED.
remedies.IWX0035: Give the parameter a fixed length that holds the longest argument any caller passes, and pass the length as another argument where it varies.
remedies.IWX0036: Position with START KEY >= or > and read forward with READ NEXT, keeping the last record whose key is below the value.
remedies.IWX0037: Write FILE SECTION. before the first file description.
remedies.IWX0038: Write PERFORM UNTIL with a condition the loop sets when it should end, in place of UNTIL EXIT.
remedies.IWX0039: Assign the file to its DD name, and name the data set in the job's JCL.
remedies.IWX0040: Make the key one data item: a group of the joined fields, contiguous in the record, named in the KEY clause.
remedies.IWX0041: Remove the extra periods, so the sentence ends with one.
remedies.IWX0042: Count the trailing spaces with INSPECT FUNCTION REVERSE (item) TALLYING ... FOR LEADING SPACES, and subtract the count from the item's length.
remedies.IWX0043: Delete the data set in the job instead: DISP=(OLD,DELETE) on its DD, or an IDCAMS DELETE step.
remedies.IWX0044: Write PROCEDURE-POINTER in place of PROGRAM-POINTER.
remedies.IWX0046: Describe the item in the LINKAGE SECTION in place of BASED, and give it storage with SET ADDRESS OF.
remedies.IWX0047: Free the storage through a pointer: SET a POINTER item TO ADDRESS OF the item, then FREE the pointer.
remedies.IWX0048: Keep the directive only where the estate compiles with Enterprise COBOL 6.3 or later; for an earlier compiler, choose the variant with a COPY member per build.
remedies.IWX0049: Remove the directive; it has no effect.
remedies.IWX0050: Mark the debugging line with D in column 7 in place of >>D.
remedies.IWX0051: Move the body into a paragraph and PERFORM it VARYING ... AFTER ..., since Enterprise COBOL takes AFTER phrases only when PERFORM names a procedure.
remedies.IWX0053: Join the values with STRING ... DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO the target, moving a number to a display item first.
remedies.IWX0054: Write the member name with one period after it, so Enterprise COBOL does not read a period as part of the name.
remedies.IWX0055: Take the PARM through PROCEDURE DIVISION USING a LINKAGE SECTION record (a halfword length and the text), in place of CHAINING.
remedies.IWX0056: Write the line with DISPLAY ... UPON SYSOUT, or to a file whose DD the job routes, in place of UPON SYSERR.
remedies.IWX0057: Read the key that ended input from the interface the program runs under on z/OS, such as EIBAID under CICS, in place of COB-CRT-STATUS.
remedies.IWX0058: Replace each tab with spaces, so every statement sits in the columns Enterprise COBOL reads.
remedies.IWX0059: Rewrite the construct in a form Enterprise COBOL compiles; under --compliance relaxed ironwork compiled it as a hole, so nothing in it was checked.
remedies.IWX0060: Compile with ARITH(EXTEND) on the program's CBL or PROCESS card, or keep the PICTURE to 18 digits.
remedies.IWX0061: Start the paragraph name in Area A, columns 8 to 11.
remedies.IWX0062: Replace the texts with INSPECT ... REPLACING where old and new are the same length, and build the result with STRING otherwise.
remedies.IWX0063: Write the literal with at least one character, or name SPACE, LOW-VALUE or another figurative constant where an empty value is meant.
